# Garden folder index

This folder holds the working notes for the garden itself, kept apart from the
planning notes at the top of the repository. At the moment it has one
document, the seal checklist for the rain barrel, which the notes on fixing the
barrel refer to. New notes about the beds, the barrel and the path go here,
and each gets a line below this one when it is added.

- [Rain barrel seal checklist](rain-barrel-checklist.md)
